name: United Fiber Optic Communication Inc.
summary: United Fiber Optic Communication Inc., along with its affiliated entities, operates as a global manufacturer and distributor of fiber-optic cables and associated transmission equipment. Its market presence extends across Taiwan, the United States, Japan, and various other international regions. The company's diverse product line features indoor and outdoor optical fiber cables, an array of accessories like patch cords, splitters, and termination panels and boxes, as well as communication systems designed for trains and traffic management. UFOC also supplies wireless technologies, including RFID products, fiber radio modules, wireless transmission devices, integrated personal locator beacons, and mobile rescue platforms. Furthermore, it offers specialized solutions for cable installation and a selection of lighting products. Beyond its hardware offerings, the company develops comprehensive solutions for smart transportation, intelligent building systems, streamlined logistics, cloud and sensing applications, and enterprise cloud storage. Its client base spans telecommunication operators and key sectors such as Mass Rapid Transit (MRT), highways, and subways. Founded in 1984, United Fiber Optic Communication Inc. maintains its primary headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
